question: Which state government launched 'Kaushalya Matritva Yojana' in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Kaushalya Matritva Yojana was launched by the Chhattisgarh government in March 2022.**
 
• The scheme aims to provide skill training to pregnant and lactating women in order to enhance their employability and income.
 
• The scheme also provides financial assistance to women during their pregnancy and childbirth.
 
• **The scheme will benefit about 50,000 women in the state.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The state government of Madhya Pradesh launched the 'Mukhya Mantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana' in March 2022.**

 
 
• The scheme aims to provide financial assistance** **to farmers for crop loss due to natural calamities.
 
 
 
• **The Haryana government launched the 'Parivar Pehchan Patra' scheme in February 2022.**
 
 
• The scheme aims to provide a unique identity to each family in the state and enable them to avail of various government schemes and services.
 
 
 
• **The Uttar Pradesh government launched the 'Kisan Mitra Yojana' in February 2022.**
 
 
• The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for the purchase of agricultural machinery and equipment.
